### trips.txt

This gives each bus or train trip on a given line (a line is also called a 'route')

### routes.txt

This gives information about each line (route), such as its name

### bus_passengers.csv

This gives bus passengers and routes taken. Each observation corresponds to a line taken as a part of an individual passenger's trip.

### train_passengers.csv

This gives train passengers and routes taken. Each observation corresponds to a line taken as a part of the passenger's trip.

### illinois_tract_income
Median household income by census tract, where "ASQPE001" is the estimated median income.
